title: SAIC as contractor for psionic testing near Crane
place_text: SAIC; Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: thinks that saic which is located right next to Naval service Warfare crane was the contractor doing the psionic testing

plain: The theory is that SAIC, a defence contracting company that sits right next to Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base in Indiana, was the contractor that carried out psionic testing, meaning tests of psychic abilities, apparently in the 1980s. If so, government psychic research would have run through a private company. Michels passes it on as someone else's belief, and the names attached to it are a person called Sammy and a man named James Woodward.
